description: One 90-day activity log, newest first. type: all (default), api_request (every request this account's API keys made from the CLI, an MCP host or the REST API: method, path, status, latency, key, request id; never a body), publishing (posts published, failed, scheduled, cancelled on this brand), webhooks (alert deliveries), connections (connected accounts and the ones needing a reconnect). Filter by status, statusCode, requestId (the X-Request-Id response header: every line of one request), apiKeyId, brandFilter, search, days (1-90), from, to; page with limit and skip. A source that could not be read is named, never shown as empty. Read-only, free.

brandFilter.description: only API requests made on this brand (its id, from list_brands)

name: list_activity_logs
title: Read the activity log
